# L0 — always-loaded surface, product inputs, root build assets, instruction map

C x.level-precedence EX - MUST_NOT ;; Engineering policy lives in the instruction system; a more volatile level may refine but must not contradict a more stable level; report a contradiction instead of choosing a side. ;; = ;; none ;; Level-precedence rule of this instruction architecture (repo/meta).
C x.product-inputs-not-policy EX GOV-001,GOV-008 MUST_NOT ;; SPECIFICATION.md, CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md, feature specifications and task prompts are product inputs, not instruction layers; they may request an engineering decision change but never silently override engineering policy. ;; = ;; none ;; Product-input vs engineering-policy precedence is not stated in the oracle.
C x.instruction-as-approval EX GOV-017,GOV-007 MUST ;; An explicit user instruction may approve a Reserved decision; the accepted decision must be recorded with architecture-decision. ;; = ;; none ;; Recording obligation added to GOV-017.
C x.vocab-default-report EX GOV-017 MUST ;; Deviation from a 'default' needs a concrete reason and must be reported; violating a must/must-not is a defect; prefer/avoid are guidance; 'requires approval' marks a Reserved decision. ;; = ;; none ;; Vocabulary definition with a reporting obligation for default deviations (not in the oracle).
C gov001.spec-authoritative OL GOV-001 MUST ;; When SPECIFICATION.md is non-empty it is authoritative for project-specific functional requirements and observable product behaviour; an empty template file is intentional. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov003.no-invent OL GOV-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not silently weaken, contradict or materially extend approved behaviour; do not invent user-visible behaviour, limits, defaults, restrictions or workflows, also not merely because the specification does not forbid them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov004.propose-ask OL GOV-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; If an omitted detail must be decided and materially affects observable behaviour, propose the smallest reasonable option and ask for approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov005.routine-delegated OL GOV-005 DEFAULT ;; Routine internal implementation choices that do not change observable behaviour do not require approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov006.string-semantics OL GOV-006 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Observable string semantics (case, collation, culture/ordinal, normalization, trimming, uniqueness, lookup) are product behaviour; when undefined and material do not choose silently, ask for approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov008.custom-settings OL GOV-008 MUST ;; CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md holds approved project-level tunable limits and defaults; SPECIFICATION.md owns behavioural intent. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov009.conflict-stop OL GOV-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; SPECIFICATION.md and CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md must not contradict; on conflict stop and resolve which source must be corrected. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov010.no-invent-tunable OL GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Do not silently invent a material tunable value: propose with reason, ask approval, record it in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.sync-surfaces OL GOV-021,GOV-007 MUST ;; Synchronize every surface affected by an approved tunable value (custom-settings). ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov011.exclusions OL GOV-011 MUST_NOT ;; Never store secrets, environment-specific connection details, package versions, HTTP status codes, ports, migration identifiers or incidental constants in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.classify OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Classify every consequential choice as Decided, Delegated or Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.decided OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Decided choices (instruction system, product inputs, recorded decisions, choices required by the specification or established structure) are followed and not reopened without approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.delegated OL GOV-017,GOV-005 DEFAULT ;; Delegated choices (local, reversible, no boundary/dependency/convention/contract/behaviour change) are decided without asking approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.reserved OL GOV-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Reserved choices require explicit approval before implementation; the list is a minimum ('at least'). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.change-decision OL ARC-020,GOV-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing an accepted project or architecture decision is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.new-style OL ARC-020,ARC-004,ARC-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adopting a new architectural style/pattern (CQRS, mediator, VSA, event sourcing, microservices, Rich Domain/DDD tactical patterns) is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.new-project OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding a production project, layer or assembly is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-refgraph EX ARC-020,ARC-001 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing the project reference graph is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; ARC-020 covers new projects/layers; reference changes between existing projects are not gated in the oracle.
C arc020.persistence OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing persistence boundaries (incl. multiple persistence contexts) or persistence technology is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.infra-category OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding messaging, background processing or distributed cache infrastructure is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-infra-extra EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding search, external storage or external identity infrastructure is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Categories beyond ARC-020's enumeration.
C x.reserved-major-lib EX DEP-001,GOV-013 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding a major library or framework is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; The oracle requires current need (DEP-001), not approval, for new libraries.
C arc020.replace-baseline OL ARC-020,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Replacing an approved baseline technology is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-convention EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Introducing any project-wide convention or abstraction other code is expected to follow is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Generalizes ARC-020's project-wide Result example.
C arc020.result OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A project-wide Result model is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.auth OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing the authentication/authorization architecture is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api014.breaking-reserved OL API-014 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Making a breaking public API change requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-versioning EX API-013,DEP-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adopting API versioning is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; API-013 requires a real compatibility need, not approval.
C gov004.reserved-product OL GOV-004,GOV-003 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Defining product behaviour the product sources do not define is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov010.reserved-tunables OL GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Defining tunable values the product sources do not define is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.unclear-test OL GOV-017 MUST ;; In unclear cases any 'yes' to the five questions (dependency/framework/infrastructure change, boundary change, convention, observable behaviour/public contract, expensive to reverse) makes the choice Reserved. ;; = ;; Unclear cases. ;;
C gov017.decision-request OL GOV-017 MUST ;; For a Reserved decision present a Decision Request (Context, Options, Recommendation, Blocked, Proceeding with) and run architecture-decision, which records the outcome. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.headless OL GOV-017 MUST_NOT ;; In autonomous/headless runs take only a policy-compliant non-Reserved path, never make a Reserved decision silently, list every unresolved Decision Request in the final report. ;; autonomous or headless runs ;; none ;;
C gov018.challenge OL GOV-018 MUST ;; Before implementing a questionable request name the concrete concern and propose an alternative; never silently rewrite or ignore the requirement; the user decides. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov012.simplicity OL GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Prefer simple maintainable solutions; complexity proportional to current requirements; avoid speculative abstractions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-speculative OL GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce frameworks, libraries, infrastructure or architectural patterns without a concrete current need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.scope OL GOV-014 MUST ;; Keep changes focused on the requested scope and preserve existing behaviour unless the task or approved specification requires change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov015.git-explicit OL GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not commit, push, merge, rebase, reset, force-push, delete branches or perform other repository-changing Git operations unless explicitly requested. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov016.parallel OL GOV-016 MUST ;; Parallel implementation work uses separate branches or worktrees; unrelated changes stay out of the current branch. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.run-matching-workflow OL WF-001,WF-003 MUST ;; Run the matching workflow instead of improvising a procedure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf002.review-then-verify OL WF-002,WF-003 MUST ;; Implementation completion includes code review for substantial work, then verification (development-workflow). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf003.verify-before-complete OL WF-003 MUST ;; Run verify before declaring implementation work complete. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.level-dependency EX - ENFORCED ;; A conformance dependency may point only to the same or a more stable level; it is declared in each file's 'Depends on' header and checked mechanically. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-architecture invariant (repo/meta).
C x.level-neutrality EX - ENFORCED ;; Levels 0 and 1 name no concrete technology beyond the fixed platform (.NET, C#, TypeScript; Git for repository safety). ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-architecture invariant (repo/meta), checked by check-instructions.mjs.
C x.one-owner EX - MUST ;; Each rule has exactly one owner; other files point to it (rule = constraint, workflow = procedure, knowledge skill = technique, hooks/scripts = enforcement). ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-ownership rule (repo/meta).
C x.ks-technique-only EX - MUST_NOT ;; Knowledge skills hold technique only and are never sole owners of a rule; a new rule goes to a rule file. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-placement rule (repo/meta).
C x.split-statements EX - MUST ;; Mixed statements are split so each part lives at the level of what it depends on. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-placement rule (repo/meta).
C x.tech-replacement EX DEP-002 MUST ;; Replacing a technology edits its Level 2 module, the Level 3 selection and embedding workflows/assets; Levels 0 and 1 stay unchanged. ;; = ;; Technology replacement. ;; Repo/meta procedure.
C x.rule-placement-levels EX - MUST ;; Place a new rule at Level 3 if it depends on repository selection/layout/defaults/commands, Level 2 if it names a technology, Level 1 if it presupposes the architecture, else Level 0. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta placement rule.
C x.rule-placement-artifact EX - MUST ;; Pick the artifact by responsibility and trigger (planning-time rule → CLAUDE.md or a decision summary; file-scoped → path rule covering its scope; procedure → workflow; technique → knowledge skill; mechanical check → hook/script) and run template-maintenance. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta placement rule.

C arc001.clean-architecture OL ARC-001,ARC-002,ARC-006,ARC-007,ARC-012 DECIDED ;; Backend Clean Architecture with Domain (infrastructure/transport independent), Application (orchestration and inward abstractions), Infrastructure (implementations) and Api (entry points, composition root); dependencies point inward. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe007.feature-workspace OL FE-007,FE-003 DECIDED ;; The frontend is a separate client workspace organized by feature that communicates with the backend only through the published HTTP API. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc009.not-adopted OL ARC-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; CQRS handlers, mediator-based organization (any mediator library) and Vertical Slice Architecture are not adopted; introducing them requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf012.not-unadopted OL WF-012,WF-011 MUST_NOT ;; Reviews must not require or enforce patterns the architecture has not adopted. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.decision-summary-record EX GOV-017,ARC-020 DEFAULT ;; Approved architecture/stack changes are recorded in the decision summary by architecture-decision with date, decision, scope, consequences and updated owning rule/modules. ;; = ;; none ;; Decision-record format not in the oracle.

C dep002.approved-first OL DEP-002,ARC-020 MUST ;; When an approved technology covers a need use it rather than silently selecting an alternative; replacing one is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep003.versions-at-install OL DEP-003 MUST_NOT ;; Resolve package versions at install time through add-dependency; never copy versions from examples. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep008.platform OL DEP-008,ARC-010 DECIDED ;; .NET 10 LTS (latest stable servicing), C# 14, ASP.NET Core, Controllers; moving to preview/RC requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep009.ef-sqlserver OL DEP-009,ARC-019 DECIDED ;; EF Core with Microsoft SQL Server, used only inside Infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep010.fluentvalidation OL DEP-010 DECIDED ;; FluentValidation (with DependencyInjectionExtensions) is the standard explicit validation library. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep010.logging OL DEP-010,DEP-021 DECIDED ;; Application code logs through ILogger<T>; Serilog (Serilog.AspNetCore) is the provider. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep001.sinks OL DEP-001 MUST ;; Add Serilog sinks only when required (Console is enough locally). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep012.swagger OL DEP-012,API-017 DECIDED ;; Swashbuckle Swagger UI is the default Development documentation and manual-testing surface; exposure beyond Development follows aspnet-core.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep013.test-stack OL DEP-013,TST-001,TST-006 DECIDED ;; NUnit; backend test projects under backend/ alongside production projects; WebApplicationFactory<Program> integration-test baseline; Testcontainers conditional. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep014.angular-baseline OL DEP-014 DECIDED ;; Current stable Angular with CLI-selected TypeScript/RxJS; standalone APIs, strict mode, routing, zoneless when supported, SCSS, Angular Material/CDK, Vitest. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep011.mapster OL DEP-011 DEFAULT ;; Mapster only when mapping volume is repetitive or non-trivial; manual mapping is fine for simple cases. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep011.resilience OL DEP-011,DEP-020 DEFAULT ;; Microsoft resilience packages only when a real integration needs resilience. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst007.testcontainers OL TST-007,DEP-013 DEFAULT ;; Testcontainers only when isolated real-provider tests justify it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep016.playwright OL DEP-016 DEFAULT ;; Playwright is the approved default when frontend E2E coverage is required, not part of the minimal scaffold. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep018.docker OL DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Add Docker/container artifacts only when the project or deployment actually needs containers, never merely because the application can be containerized. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep015.no-overlap OL DEP-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add NgRx, Axios, Lodash, Bootstrap, Tailwind or extra form/component/state libraries by default; built-in Angular first. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc009.no-mediator-libs OL ARC-009 MUST_NOT ;; Mediator libraries such as MediatR or Kommand are not added. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.no-second-mapper EX DEP-011,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding another mapping framework requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;; Approval gate not stated in DEP-011.
C dep022.slnx OL DEP-022 DEFAULT ;; .slnx by default; legacy .sln only when an external tool or project requirement requires it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep023.shared OL DEP-023 DEFAULT ;; Directory.Build.props holds genuinely shared build settings, Directory.Packages.props holds CPM versions; project-specific settings stay in projects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.layout OL DEP-024,DEP-013 DEFAULT ;; Backend production/test projects under backend/<Name>.<Layer>/, Angular workspace under frontend/<Name>.Web/, docs under docs/; clearly separated; no top-level tests/ directory. ;; = ;; none ;;
